## Ringkasan

ACM membagi nominal Request CIT ke vault (CASH / ATM_CASH); setiap alokasi mendapat tiket pemenuhan vault. ATM-SPV meninjau penetapan vault di halaman Request CIT (approve / reject).

## Peran (role)

Menu sidebar CompanyPortal (`navigation.ts`):

- **Penetapan Vault** `/cit/vault-plans`: ACM-USER, ACM-SPV

Route frontend:
